LanguageData.SmartWallLights.DesignatorDesc: Click inside a closed room to place an efficient set of wall light blueprints along its walls. You can also hold Shift while placing a supported wall light on a room wall.
LanguageData.SmartWallLights.NoWallLampDef: SmartWallLights could not find a supported wall light definition.
LanguageData.SmartWallLights.RoomTooSmall: This room is too small for automatic wall-light placement.
LanguageData.SmartWallLights.NoCandidates: No valid wall cells for wall lights were found in this room.
LanguageData.SmartWallLights.NothingToPlace: This room already appears to be covered by wall lights.
LanguageData.SmartWallLights.Partial: Placed {0} wall light(s), but {1} room cell(s) could not be covered from valid wall positions.
LanguageData.SmartWallLights.Settings.ModeEfficient: Efficient: balanced coverage by wall segments
LanguageData.SmartWallLights.Settings.ModeFullSymmetr: Full symmetry: opposite wall lamps face each other
LanguageData.SmartWallLights.Settings.ModeHybrid: Hybrid: symmetric pairs first, efficient fill for dark cells
